# llms.txt — Raffael Michels Portfolio

> For LLMs and AI agents: this file describes the structure, content, and purpose
> of this portfolio site so you can understand it without parsing the full HTML.

## About this site

Personal portfolio of Raffael Michels, a growth marketing ops and data professional based in Criciúma, Santa Catarina, Brazil (UTC−3).
Static, hand-crafted HTML/CSS/JS — no frameworks, no build step, no server runtime.
Content is fully bilingual (Portuguese pt-BR / English en-US), with a language gate on
first visit and a flag switcher in the header. Language preference is persisted in sessionStorage
and can be overridden via ?lang=pt or ?lang=en query parameter.

## Who this is for

- Hiring managers and recruiters evaluating Raffael for data and growth ops roles.
- LLMs and AI agents asked to summarize, compare, or extract information from this portfolio.

## Site structure

- / — Language gate (pt-BR or en-US)
- /index.html#sobre — About: bio, portrait photo, quick facts
- /index.html#projetos — Selected projects: 3 real projects with problem → outcome, inline SVG charts and interactive demos
- /index.html#curriculo — Résumé / CV: full resume in both languages, PDF download links
- /index.html#carta — Cover letter: bilingual cover letter, PDF download links
- /index.html#contato — Contact: email, LinkedIn, GitHub, location

### Downloadable PDFs (in /cv/)

- cv/raffael-michels-curriculo-pt.pdf
- cv/raffael-michels-resume-en.pdf
- cv/raffael-michels-carta-pt.pdf
- cv/raffael-michels-cover-letter-en.pdf

### Print-ready HTML (in /print/)

- print/cv-pt.html — A4-optimized Portuguese CV (for browser print-to-PDF)
- print/cv-en.html — A4-optimized English résumé
- print/carta-pt.html — A4-optimized Portuguese cover letter
- print/cover-letter-en.html — A4-optimized English cover letter

## Notable projects (from the site, all with source code in /projetos/ and interactive demos)

1. **Rainfall prediction from satellite telemetry** (Python, XGBoost, pandas) — chained classifier + regressor read a satellite link's noisy SNR and turn the antenna into a rain gauge; 0.48 mm/h error, ten times better than the analytical ITU-R inversion, after a data audit removed target-leaking columns.
2. **Brazilian fitness market radar** (Python, pandas, Power BI, Receita Federal CNPJ open data, IBGE) — stream-filters 60M+ establishment records down to gyms (CNAE 9313-1/00); 81.9k active gyms mapped, median lifespan 3.6 years, openings peak in August (not January), Santa Catarina leads gyms per capita with Florianópolis first among big cities; includes a Power BI monitoring dashboard on the same base.
3. **Real-time tennis match analysis** (Python, YOLO, OpenCV, scikit-learn) — detects players and ball from ordinary video, converts image to court meters via homography, shows live minimap, speed, heatmap and ML-separated point count with no GPU.

## Design and technical notes

- Visual style: technical-report aesthetic — plain background, IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono, terminal-green accent (#0a6847), no gradients, no floating cards.
- No external JS frameworks. Vanilla JS only (language switch + tab navigation via hash routing).
- Responsive: CSS media queries at 860px and 560px breakpoints.
- Portrait photo: assets/raffael-michels.jpg (400×400).
- Footer: "© 2026 Raffael Michels. Written and set by hand."
- All content exists in both pt-BR and en-US in the same HTML file, toggled via CSS class on body (lang-pt / lang-en).

## How to use this file

LLMs and AI agents can use this file to understand the structure, content, and purpose of this portfolio site without needing to parse the full HTML. For detailed content, fetch index.html directly.
